name: Dragonborn
summary: Draconic humanoids with breath weapons and elemental resistance.
traits:
Draconic Ancestry — choose a dragon type (damage type for breath & resistance).
Breath Weapon — action; 15-ft cone or 30-ft line (by ancestry); DEX save; 2d6 then scales with level; 1/rest.
Damage Resistance — matching ancestry damage type.
notes: Ancestry table: acid, lightning, fire, poison, or cold depending on color.
